requirements.text: Service desk reachable 7:30–19:00 on working days, by phone, email and portal.
Blocking incidents (P1): guaranteed response time (GTI) of 4 working hours maximum and guaranteed resolution time (GTR) of 8 working hours.
Monthly service-level dashboard and quarterly steering committee.
ITIL or equivalent approach for incidents, requests and changes.
Data hosted in the European Union; no transfer outside the EU without written consent.
Data-processing agreement compliant with GDPR article 28, signed at award.
Security assurance plan (PAS) submitted with the bid: access management, logging, security patches within 30 days.
Remote control of workstations only with the user's consent and a trace of every session.
Dedicated project manager with at least 5 years of public-sector managed-services experience.
Transition phase of 2 months maximum, with a joint inventory of the estate.
Exit reversibility plan: data and documentation returned in an open format.
Refurbishment of replaced workstations and data-destruction certificate.
BPU: monthly support fee and work units (workstation install, site call-out); DQE simulation completed without changing quantities.

company_desc: past proposals, ITIL processes, template PAS, GDPR templates, CVs

chunks.title: Past proposal — Port-Brumeux community of communes, 320-seat managed services (2024)
chunks.text: Service desk open 7:30–19:00 on working days (phone, email, portal). P1 incidents: 4 working-hour response, 8 working-hour resolution; 97% of P1s on time in 2025 (fictional internal figure). 3 field technicians, 4 at the service desk.

chunks.title: Template — Monthly SLA dashboard and steering committee
chunks.text: Monthly indicators: ticket volume, response / resolution times by priority, satisfaction, backlog. Quarterly steering committee with action plan and gap tracking.

chunks.title: Process — Incidents, requests and changes (ITIL)
chunks.text: Service catalogue, P1 to P4 priorities, change management with a weekly board, knowledge base updated with every resolved ticket.

chunks.title: Sheet — Data and tool hosting (EU)
chunks.text: Ticketing tool and backups hosted in the European Union. No transfer outside the EU. List of sub-processors shared with the client.

chunks.title: Template — Data-processing agreement (GDPR article 28)
chunks.text: Article 28 clause template: purpose and duration of processing, security measures, sub-processors, assistance to the controller, data at end of contract.

chunks.title: Template security assurance plan
chunks.text: Named accounts with two-factor authentication, logs kept 12 months, critical patches deployed within 15 days, quarterly access review, security-incident procedure.

chunks.title: Procedure — Remote control with user consent
chunks.text: Each remote session is accepted by the user on screen, time-stamped and linked to the ticket. No standing access without a request.

chunks.title: CV — Élodie Marchal, managed-services project manager
chunks.text: Élodie Marchal (fictional person): 9 years running managed-services contracts for local authorities, 150 to 600 seats. Chairs steering committees and transitions.

chunks.title: Method — 8-week transition
chunks.text: Weeks 1–3: joint inventory and documentation handover. Weeks 4–6: shadowing the incumbent team. Weeks 7–8: gradual cut-over and client sign-off.

chunks.title: Template exit reversibility plan
chunks.text: Data, knowledge base and documentation returned in open formats (CSV, ODT). Support to the successor during handover.

C1.title: Section 1 — Support organisation and service levels

bullets.text: Service desk reachable 7:30–19:00 on working days, by phone, email and portal, as for the Port-Brumeux community of communes.
Incidents, requests and changes handled under our ITIL processes, priorities P1 to P4.
Monthly SLA dashboard and quarterly steering committee.
GDPR article 28 data-processing agreement ready to sign at award.
Security assurance plan attached: named accounts with two-factor authentication, logs kept 12 months, critical patches within 15 days.
Remote control only after user consent, each session time-stamped and linked to the ticket.
Team: 3 field technicians and 4 service-desk technicians, on the Port-Brumeux contract model.
Joint inventory of the estate, shadowing period, then gradual cut-over signed off by the buyer.
Exit reversibility: data and documentation returned in open formats (CSV, ODT).
BPU completed (monthly fee and work units); DQE completed without changing quantities.

form.notes: Joint inventory carried out site by site with each municipality's IT contact.
